correctness.rationale: For the labelled open ladder P_n square K_2, n>=2, interior vertices have three distinct neighbors and degree-two ends use their own previous spin as tie breaker. Pair consecutive binary rung states in 16 symbols (x_top,x_bottom,y_top,y_bottom); 256 ordered symbol pairs are transfer vertices. For each middle triple the four majority constraints for F(x)=y and F(y)=x determine 400 allowed directed transitions, while end constraints generate 36-element boundary vectors. Independently reconstructing these finite operators gave the integer vector annihilators (T^5-3T^4+T^3-T^2+3T-I)e=0 and (Tf^3-2Tf^2+I)ef=0, all 512 coordinates exactly zero. Their initial counts P_2..P_6=(8,22,48,124,326), Q_2..Q_4=(6,8,12) yield P_n=Lucas_(2n)+1+3[3|n] and Q_n=2(Fibonacci_(n+1)+1) for all n>=2 via factored characteristic polynomials. Symmetric ±1 threshold energy E_t=-sigma_t^T W sigma_(t-1) strictly descends when sigma_(t+1)!=sigma_(t-1), since each W sigma_t coordinate is odd nonzero, so there are no eventual periods above two. Primitive 2-orbit count is (P_n-Q_n)/2, with the asserted asymptotic. The exhaustive vector identities are a finite exact certificate for the infinite-length recurrence, not a mere short-length numerical pattern.

value.rationale: The open two-row ladder is a basic non-tree bounded-width graph with natural synchronous majority dynamics. Complete labelled fixed/period-two orbit formulas, their exact modulo-three resonance, and distinct primitive-orbit normalization are useful natural invariants beyond generic eventual-period results; the finite transfer annihilator establishes an infinite census rather than a small-instance observation.

limitations: No basin sizes or transient depths, and no claim for cyclic ladders/wider strips.
Classic symmetric-threshold period bound is not novel; originality of exact labelled all-n census is a qualified best-of-knowledge judgment.
